result.keyword: What's the best payment processor for a small online store?
result.markdown:
For a small online store in the UK, my recommendation would be **Stripe for most businesses**, with Shopify Payments being the better choice if your website runs on Shopify.

The best option depends on your website platform, transaction volume and the types of payments you want to accept.

## My top 5 payment processors

![CPGIO - Multichannel eCommerce Solutions](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/PjgYNLsLO5kyHaLbRGf_vEGDklf86yBgljtBg18t7Dvw-WgJwtAR87t17RVnZQNRleNsnU2jfdTsx-hJkwGMn58MvL69dhGg6Mz4413HP_F8ItDmZVpm38tgVXpxLOBbHgVAgnhtZKjtJgc5PKyPg4Dx8NXHfNqw_93O-hccPsS0BrwP9sqrs9aaI_I6CV7n?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Stripe**

(Best overall)

- UK card fees: approximately 1.5% + 20p
- No monthly processing fee
- Excellent fraud protection
- Supports Apple Pay, Google Pay and subscriptions

Website: [Stripe UK](https://stripe.com/gb)

---

![Shopify Payments w Polsce – jak działa, koszty, wdrożenie, zalety - Adtrip](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/tzlxg0Y9z5dRoMa7puRQ5gUF-G3hcQ7FEcuVco38BEG917LKXepufVl9cw-FwTKDdqoHqkcHNs202c43Bsg-KXxlvnrYPNEJMBSIYJqLREQ2DlgIvAOQgkKyUCOU_zdRd59gIwC2e-5cs0YCLvv_6mYa-9FiK4qFkvvkawoheALPlNv3AkWQkvUMElw-UVk8?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Shopify Payments**

(Best for Shopify stores)

- Integrated directly into Shopify
- No separate third-party gateway required
- Supports major cards and digital wallets
- Fees depend on your Shopify subscription

Website: [Shopify Payments](https://www.shopify.com/uk/payments)

---

![square-logo](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/1usVU99QTc623Z1qK0LnerrVUCFuaCZRY9kzKFoWI_Gdr9NcpX1vWKOmILymiErxn6ndDcZZ0Or5-PjPVYj_lTK1K9NB9Q8Cck3TogeQjE13w7S0OC_soTbxUb84o9oqvCcpbffi8RgWQf3ncfxvUqtopiXbgd9lTiIMfcExXBRU8XgKgcPu-V2QhGDsZYzn?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Square**

- Online UK card fees: approximately 1.4% + 25p
- Free entry-level plan
- Good for online and physical shops
- Straightforward setup

Website: [Square UK](https://squareup.com/gb/en)

---

![Download the PayPal logo in PNG y SVG | LogosDown](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/MAzkiJ1YuDnyj2FyYAyszlEHA_k7S0XqFuDRhbVDc0cICTj1-X82VJgt7N8vcRcKsONlo3HvF0Pe2MUizAJnEXGjXwhkQKSdT9w8dASkeKU2hONBc_K0UGh46cKL9ey1QEsmTJtnMOjwtp9k8flMfotUdye-2o09Vcb_X37Fr_RqbfMx2vNQ-Z2QRLli3zQI?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. PayPal Checkout**

- Familiar and trusted by many shoppers
- Allows customers to pay using PayPal
- Useful as an additional checkout option
- Generally higher transaction fees

Website: [PayPal Business](https://www.paypal.com/uk/business)

---

![GreenTheUK | Conservation and Restoration Projects on Land and Sea](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/GpMWPKmQS0ivwb-vUrMJkoXbMY1YHqZLwczazSCgdTNcSpJToMo9TAxWp3DhHLau7K-m_pvzIgRa052-pcyd7VM-LR612mPLmmz7ttDEvyaNHcIuOSULexyB1JDi6PwpQQWkWRqgJ1D4MJL-DyzM2xMQWnSpYE5tgYRB8SsU_jbXzNUfVx_kjgv1l2qMxiZs?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. GoCardless**

- Great for recurring payments
- Direct Debit from customers' bank accounts
- Particularly useful for subscriptions
- Less suited to conventional one-off card purchases

Website: [GoCardless](https://gocardless.com/)

Indicative UK pricing; actual rates depend on card type, transaction type and subscription. Sources: [www.businessexpert.co.uk](https://www.businessexpert.co.uk/payment-processing/best-online-payment-solutions/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[whito.co.uk](https://whito.co.uk/tools/best-payment-processors-for-uk-businesses/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.intelivita.co.uk](https://www.intelivita.co.uk/blog/best-online-payment-gateways?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## What I would choose

| Your situation | My choice |
|--------|--------|
| New small online store | Stripe |
| Shopify website | Shopify Payments |
| Online and physical shop | Square |
| Want PayPal checkout | PayPal alongside Stripe |
| Monthly subscriptions | Stripe or GoCardless |
